completion_mode: Actual prospective freeze and bounded development qualification of the generated-code study. Final material remains sealed. Compact rescue removed the bulky bootstrap inventory from the preparation tree.

criteria.criterion: Qualify actual model, weights, tokenizer, revision, chat template, deployment, prompt and decoding pins with real bounded development calls. For every qualified call, require returned prompt_tokens to equal that call's retained preflight input_count, not merely stay below 2048. Qualify 1024 output-token ceiling, seed behavior, raw response preservation, cancellation and actual model-service resource accounting. Reuse a warm model while actively inferring; preserve 10000 seconds of total service wall and a separate 360-second startup-readiness bound. Do not make systemd or an indefinitely running model a prerequisite.
criteria.explanation: A bounded child HTTP model service loaded frozen NumPy weights, tokenizer, chat template and deployment pins. Actual development calls returned prompt_tokens equal to retained preflight input_count. Output ceiling 1024, seed retained, raw responses preserved, shutdown/cancellation recorded. Startup was under 360s; service wall 10000s; systemd and an indefinitely running model are not required.

criteria.criterion: Qualify a hard complete-attempt 120-second boundary across template/tokenization/inference, all generated-program execution and cleanup. Preserve the full 8-call/2048-input/1024-output and zero-paid-budget contract. Retain actual descendant CPU, memory, model/service costs, transport wall and all overruns/unknowns. Explicitly investigate and regression-test the retained LA-030 v2 native watchdog resource_observation_OSError during terminal observation. Its exact errno/path/cause is unproven by the historical receipt. First retain operation/path/errno plus leaf/parent identity snapshots in a new diagnostic implementation; do not suppress OSError broadly or upgrade the failed receipt. Any benign-disappearance handling must revalidate stable parent identity, monotonic counters and empty state. Retained parent accounting and whole-group exit remain mandatory.
criteria.explanation: The driver contract is 120-second attempts, 8 calls, 2048 input and 1024 output tokens, paid budget 0. Watchdog diagnostics retain operation/path/errno and leaf/parent identity. The LA-030 v2 resource_observation_OSError receipt is not upgraded and its errno remains unproven. Benign leaf disappearance revalidates stable parent identity, monotonic counters and empty state.

These are actual bounded probes, not configuration flags.
